summary: Exercise Talon Storm: multiple helicopters conducting low-level tactical training within 5 nautical miles of Hullavington, up to 1,100 feet.
text:
EXER TALON STORM. MULTIPLE HEL OPERATING LOW LEVEL CONDUCTING 
TACTICAL TRAINING WI 5NM RADIUS OF 513149N 0020824W (HULLAVINGTON). 
ACFT MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO 01449 728240. 
AR-2026-9719/01.
